description: This Java class defines the entity 'CreditBureauLoanProductMapping' which maps credit bureau information to loan products in the system. It includes fields for credit check requirements, stale period, active status, and references to an organization credit bureau and a loan product. It also includes a static method for creating an instance from a JSON command.

classes.name: CreditBureauLoanProductMapping
classes.description: Entity class representing the mapping between a credit bureau and a loan product with associated configurations.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static factory method that creates an instance of CreditBureauLoanProductMapping from a JsonCommand object, along with related entities.
